# Manifest Metals website

This is the marketing site for Manifest Metals, LLC, a metal roofing and siding contractor based in El Paso, Texas. Every page exists in English and Spanish. It is a static site with no framework, no npm and no dependencies. GitHub Pages serves the repo root from `main`.

Read `HANDOFF.md` for the project's history, what's still open, and how the site is hosted.

## The one rule that matters most

**Never hand-edit the generated HTML.** Every `index.html`, `404.html` and `sitemap.xml` is generated by `_build/build.py`. Make changes in the build script (or in `assets/css/site.css` / `assets/js/site.js`), then rebuild:

```
python3 _build/build.py      # prints "Built 19 pages"
```

Commit the source change together with the regenerated HTML. The build is deterministic: running it on a clean checkout should produce no diff. If it does produce a diff, someone hand-edited an output file.

Preview locally:

```
python3 -m http.server 8000   # then open http://localhost:8000
```

## Layout

| Path | What it is |
|---|---|
| `_build/build.py` | All page content (EN + ES copy), layout, nav, SEO/JSON-LD, sitemap. Almost every edit happens here. |
| `_build/logo.py` | The Manifest emblem (sun + five feathers) redrawn as inline SVG |
| `_build/art.py` | Panel cross-section diagrams, icons, footer ridge line |
| `assets/css/site.css` | All styles. Brand tokens are defined on `:root` at the top of the file. |
| `assets/js/site.js` | Mobile menu, scroll reveal, color visualizer, photo lightbox, quote form submit |
| `assets/img/p/` | **Real** Manifest job photos (`el1-3` El Paso, `gv1-5` Galveston, `job1-5` Houston area), as WebP at 800 and 1280/1600 wide |
| `assets/img/r/` | Color visualizer renders (`k-<color>-800/1600.webp`), one per chart color |
| `assets/fonts/` | Self-hosted Archivo, Inter, IBM Plex Mono (no Google Fonts calls) |
| `CNAME` | Currently **absent** on purpose (see HANDOFF.md) |

### How build.py works
- `PAGES` maps each page key to its EN and ES path. To add a page, add it to `PAGES`, write a `page_<name>()` function, register it in `BUILDERS`, and add it to `NAV` and/or the footer if it should be linked.
- `tr(en, es)` returns the right language. **Every visible string goes through `tr()`**, so a new sentence needs both English and Spanish. The Spanish is Mexican/Border Spanish ("platicarlo", "cotización"). Keep that register and don't switch to Castilian Spanish.
- `url(key)` and `asset(path)` produce relative links, so pages work at any base path. The 404 page is the exception: `main()` rewrites its links to root-absolute (`/assets/...`).
- `IMAGES` lists the widths generated for every photo. A new photo needs WebP files at those widths in `assets/img/p/` plus an entry in `IMAGES`. `img_path()` decides between `p/` and `r/` by name prefix (`job`, `el`, `gv` → `p/`).
- `COLORS` holds the 12 colors on the current 26 ga chart.
- Business constants sit at the top of the file: `PHONE`, `TEL`, `EMAIL`, `FORM_ENDPOINT`, `SITE_URL`, `AREAS`.

## Copy rules (business rules; don't break them)
These are also at the top of `build.py`:
- **No prices** anywhere.
- **No license, insurance, bonding, warranty or review/testimonial claims** until the owner verifies them.
- Texas only. For energy savings, cite only the EPA cool-roofs figure (`EPA_URL`).
- Insurance/hail copy says an eligible UL 2218 Class 4 roof **"may"** qualify for a discount and tells the homeowner to confirm with their insurer first. No statute citations and no fire-rating comparisons.
- Colors: only the 12 on the chart. **Never "Bronze"** (it was removed on purpose).
- Project write-ups **never include a customer's name or street address**.
- Project photos must be real Manifest jobs. Diagrams and the color visualizer are labeled as illustrations (the footer says so).
- Keep lifespan and product claims hedged as "typical industry range, not a warranty".

## Real specs used on the site
- Standing seam: 24 ga steel, 1-3/4" snap-lock seam, 18" panels, striated, concealed clips. Recommended for homes.
- R-panel: 26 ga, 36" coverage, exposed fasteners, 12 chart colors.
- Minimum pitch 3:12 for both systems.
- Process: aerial measurement report, then a site visit with a checklist for the roof type, photos before any price, priced at the office in writing, and nobody on a roof alone.
- Service area (`AREAS`): El Paso, Horizon City, Socorro, San Elizario, Clint, Fabens, Canutillo, Vinton, Anthony TX. Projects have also been done in Galveston and the Houston area.

## Brand
- Maroon `#8b1a1a` (the CSS token is named `--copper` for historical reasons) with charcoal/ink neutrals and warm paper backgrounds.
- Display font Archivo; body font Inter; labels in Plex Mono.
- Logo: sun with five feathers, in `_build/logo.py`. `assets/img/logo.png` is used for schema/OG.

## Quote form
The form on `/contact/#quote` posts via `fetch` to FormSubmit (`https://formsubmit.co/ajax/manifestmetalsep@gmail.com`), which emails the lead. It has a honeypot (`_honey`) and FormSubmit's captcha is turned off. The first live submission triggers a one-time activation email to that inbox, and nothing arrives until someone clicks the link in it. To route leads elsewhere, change `EMAIL` / `FORM_ENDPOINT` in `build.py` and rebuild.

## Before committing
1. `python3 _build/build.py`
2. Preview at 375px (phone) and desktop widths, in both EN and ES.
3. Earlier work checked accessibility with axe and had zero violations. Keep headings in order, keep contrast passing, and write real alt text in both languages.
4. Commit source + generated files together.
